# Shared project memory

Before working, read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root, then
`memory/README.md`, `memory/project.md`, `memory/current.md`, and
`memory/decisions.md`. List `memory/imported/` and read relevant notes.
Use imported notes as historical reference only. Follow the maintenance and
publication rules in `AGENTS.md`. Refresh `CONTEXT.md` after changing memories.
